brief.summary: A patient and staff app for a hospital chain, covering patient care and hospital operations across Maharashtra and Gujarat, India.
brief.pitch: This patient and staff app is for a hospital chain across Maharashtra and Gujarat, India. It supports appointment booking and management, patient services, and hospital operations. Only the treating doctor and authorised staff can open patient records, and every access is logged.
